<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C8H14NO (C=8, H=14, N=1, X=0), the calculation yields (16 + 2 + 1 − 14)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the compound’s structure corresponds to 2 degrees of unsaturation (one carbonyl and one ring). Therefore, the integer DBE is 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
